# downsocial Threads Video Downloader
> Free online tool to download Meta Threads Videos, Voice Notes, Carousel Photos, and Audio clips in HD MP4 and MP3 without watermarks or login.

- https://downsocial.net/threads-downloader/

## Key Capabilities
- Meta Threads Video Downloader in original 1080p Full HD
- Threads Voice Note & Speech Clip extraction to 320kbps MP3
- Threads Carousel Multi-Photo post downloader
- Zero watermarks, zero branding overlays
- No Threads or Instagram account login required
- High-speed cloud streaming, safe and anonymous
